preregistrationLimit: This is a user-proposed follow-on hypothesis after prior development results. It is not immutable preregistration or independent provenance.
objective: Evaluate one causal five-entry green-candle-streak BTC/USD rule on the persisted accepted v2 candle artifact without opening holdout unless every existing development qualification gate passes at a declared allocation.

execution.signal: After three consecutive completed green one-minute candles (close > open), start a cycle only while flat.
execution.fills: Buy five equal tranches at the next five one-minute opens. Sell all accumulated BTC at the immediately following sixth one-minute open. Signals from the active cycle are ignored; no overlapping cycle is permitted.
execution.allocationCap: Each cycle's total genuine allocation is capped at allocationRate times the $9,900 genuine sleeve, subject to available genuine cash; each tranche is one fifth of that cycle allocation.
execution.boundary: A cycle is started only when all five entry opens and its sixth sell open are observable by or before the window boundary. Any open position is force-closed at the boundary open without reading a later candle.
execution.qualificationOverlay: The existing exact deficit-to-five round-trip overlay remains separately attributed and does not produce signals.

qualification: Use the existing developmentQualificationGate unchanged: every offset must have more positive than negative windows, positive mean and median return, positive expectancy and profit factor above one, positive total P&L, positive genuine P&L, and positive mean return.
holdoutPolicy: Evaluate only development first. Open holdout once only if an allocation passes every existing development qualification gate; otherwise output NO WINNER and keep holdout sealed.
